propositions: step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError which does not match the UnretryableOutputError catch in CompletionAgentStep.run, preventing bounded recovery from engaging
LLMRunnerError is a strict ancestor of UnretryableOutputError in the exception hierarchy, so catching only UnretryableOutputError misses budget exhaustion cases
bounded recovery mechanism must become reachable for budget exhaustion to isolate criteria in fresh agentic history and converge evidence runs at 16 steps
a new LLMBudgetExhaustedError subclass of LLMRunnerError must be introduced to make budget exhaustion identifiable by type rather than message or diagnostic shape sniffing
CompletionAgentStep.run must extend its exception handler to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover while preserving the budget diagnostic on failure_diagnostic
